findings.finding: TPS54302 EN (pad 5) is left floating. This is correct: the internal pull-up (0.7 uA) enables the part and the internal VIN UVLO (3.8-4.4 V rising, 3.3-3.9 V falling) lets it start and run in 100 % duty dropout on a 5 V-only port (+5V about 4.6-4.7 V), so the ESP32 still runs. A UVLO divider like the EVM's (510k/105k, 6.74 V start) would leave a 5 V port fully dark; tying EN to VBUS would exceed EN abs max 7 V.
findings.evidence: TI SLVSDG6C rev C table 4-1 ('Float the EN pin to enable'), sec 5.1 (EN abs max 7 V), 5.5 (VIN UVLO, EN thresholds 1.23-1.28/1.1-1.16 V, Ip 0.7 uA), 6.3.5, 6.3.10 (100 % duty); netlist: pad 5 alone on its net; docs/review-3/sims/power/lite_u2_en.py (PASS: no copper on pad 5; FB and BOOT pads 0.95 mm)
findings.reference_design: TPS54302EVM-716 (SLVUAP9B sec 1.3.3, BOM): R4 510k / R5 105k UVLO divider, JP1 open = enabled; datasheet pin table allows floating
findings.fix: None needed. Optional contingency: DNP 0603 EN-GND footprint for a 1-10 nF filter cap (start delay 1.8-18 ms).
findings.margin: 5 V port: 4.75 V min source minus about 0.05 V cable drop, against 4.4 V max UVLO rising: 0.3 V. 21 V max PD against 28 V recommended / 30 V abs: 7 V.

findings.finding: PVDD turn-on: firmware soft_start_ms 100 releases the amps (RESET high) while PVDD is still ramping (t90 122/155/196 ms after PVDD_EN at 28/20/15 V). Zone B's C311 raised the bulk to 1410 uF, so Q1 sees 14.8 W peak and 0.55 J at 28 V (round-1 fix was sized for 940 uF). An amp drawing current while Q1 is in its linear ramp adds Vds x I_load.
findings.evidence: pvdd/core_fw_on_{28,20,15}v (t90 0.142/0.175/0.216 s from t=0, EN at 20 ms; pfet 14.8 W, efet 0.55 J); hwde soa_check --hotswap AO4485 1410u 28 V 75 ms: Tj 125 C at 40 C, 135 C at 50 C; with 1 A load 286 C; firmware hifi_power.c hifi_power_cfg_core soft_start_ms=100 (its comment cites only the 10-90 % time, 47 ms, not the 76 ms delay)
findings.reference_design: TPA3220 SLASEN3B 9.x: hold RESET until PVDD is stable; AO4485 SOA fig 9/10
findings.fix: C4 100 nF -> 200 nF by adding a parallel 100nF/50V 0603 (C14663, Basic); C8 2.2 uF -> ~4.4 uF by adding a parallel 2.2uF/50V 0805 (C377773, Basic); firmware hifi_power_cfg_core soft_start_ms = 500. FIX sim: 7.7 W peak, t90 244 ms after EN, Vsg on the 5->28 V step 1.15 V (holds off), Tj 96 C at 50 C ambient.
findings.margin: now: Tj 135 C vs 150 C at 50 C ambient with no load, negative with load during the ramp; FIX: 54 K

findings.finding: The governor (hifi_gov.c) limits the 1 s mean input power to 0.9 x the contract's V*I. A sustained low-crest signal (test tone, room sweep, sub-bass) at that mean draws sin^2 current, peaking at 1.7-1.8x the PDO current for every charger checked. The bulk caps can't carry the 80-200 Hz ripple (690-1410 uF against a 0.15 ohm source). Lite has no thermal cap configured (thermal_out_w = 0; L1's 13 W/ch is not implemented), so the condition holds indefinitely; core only for the first ~60 s (thermal tau). Result: charger OCP, hard reset, ESP32 brown-out/reboot, then a repeat. Overlaps R3-SYSTEM-1. Its uncommitted hifi_gov.c change in the working tree (tau 1 s -> 50 ms) still limits a mean: a 40 Hz sine's sin^2 peaks are 2x the 50 ms mean, so the 1.7x stands unless the budget is applied to the peak or the 0.9 fraction is halved for low-crest signals.
findings.evidence: sims/power/charger_peak.py (FAIL): Lite 60 W 5.27 A pk vs 3 A; Lite 45 W 3.92 vs 2.25; core 45 W 3.84 vs 2.25; core 65 W 5.63 vs 3.25; core 140 W 8.83 vs 5 A; firmware hifi_gov.c (budget_frac 0.9, tau 1 s), board_lite.c (no thermal_out_w)
findings.reference_design: USB PD: the source guarantees its PDO current; overload is only allowed per the PDO Peak Current bits (most chargers 00)
findings.fix: Firmware: add a 10-20 ms window limit, idle + p_out_inst/eff <= 1.0 x V*I_pdo (fast attack, as now), keeping the 1 s mean limit; core: clamp gain when INA186 ISENSE > i_max for > 5 ms; Lite: implement firmware-requirements L1 (13 W/ch 30 s), which on its own brings a 60 W charger to ~1.0x. Bench: 40 Hz sine at max volume on 45 W and 60 W chargers, log VBUS/PG for 5 min.

findings.finding: Core has no VBUS ADC. hifi_ch224_vbus() takes VBUS = 20 V for any non-EPR PD contract, and board_core.c feeds that to the sequencer (14 V start floor) and to the governor (contract.v * i_max). On chargers without a 20 V PDO (18-30 W: 5/9/12/15 V) or on a 5 V-only PD source, the floor is bypassed and the budget is overstated by up to 20/9 = 2.2x. What the CH224Q settles at when 28/20 V isn't offered is not documented.
findings.evidence: firmware/components/hifi/core/hifi_pd.c hifi_ch224_vbus, esp/board_core.c lines 160-173; WCH CH224 V2.0 has no fallback rule; felixardyansyah CH224A tests show 'not supported' results
findings.reference_design: WCH CH224 V2.0 5.2.3: CH224Q 0x60-0x8F holds the full SRCCAP
findings.fix: Firmware: read SRCCAP (0x60-0x8F) after the handshake; assume 20 V only if a 20 V fixed PDO exists, else the highest fixed PDO <= 20 V for the budget; don't set PVDD_EN unless a >= 15 V PDO is present (as Lite's v_start). Bench: 18 W, 30 W and 45 W chargers, logging status/0x50 and the INA186.
findings.margin: budget overstated by 1.33x (15 V) to 2.2x (9 V)

findings.finding: Firmware can close PVDD on the SPR contract (status bit 3, then a 200 ms settle) before the CH224Q completes EPR entry. The 20 -> 28 V step then charges 1410 uF with Q1 on, or with Q1 mid-ramp. An ideal source supplies 26.6 A at the 30 V/ms PD slew; a real one current-limits. Whether a given EPR charger rides through (11.3 mC; 2.3 ms at 5 A) or OCPs and hard-resets is charger-dependent. Whether CH224Q PG releases during EPR entry is unknown.
findings.evidence: pvdd/core_epr_step_20to28_on (isrc 26.6 A, pfet 11.3 W); hifi_power.c settle_ms 200; board_core.c pg = status & 0x18
findings.reference_design: USB PD 3.1 EPR entry: SPR explicit contract first, then EPR_Mode, then EPR request
findings.fix: Firmware: if status bit 5 (EPR offered), require bit 4 (EPR active) before PVDD_EN; and only 500 ms after the last contract change or the firmware's own VREQ write.

findings.finding: Hot plug into a non-compliant live source (1 uH/50 mohm cable): Lite VBUS 32.2 V vs TPS54302/TPA3118 30 V abs; core VBUS 43.6 V vs SY8303 40 V / INA186 42 V. CH224Q VBUS_PD 28.8 V (R17/C1). A compliant 5 V attach rings to 9.0/8.9 V.

SY8303 Cin C10 (10uF/50V X5R 1206) is 2.6 uF typ / 1.75 uF low at 28 V, against 'at least 4.7 uF'. Round 1's justification ('470 uF bulk through Q1's body') is wrong while PVDD is off: the body diode conducts PVDD->VBUS and is not in the buck's input loop.
findings.evidence: hwde mlcc_dcbias 10u 1206 50 V at 29.4 V: 2.64 uF (1.75 low); AN_SY8303 pin table
findings.fix: Add a 10uF/50V 1206 (C13585, Basic) at U4 IN-GND

findings.finding: Inductor Isat (L9 3.2 A, L5 3.2-3.5 A) is below the buck current limits (SY8303 4-6.8 A, TPS54302 4-6 A); normal peaks 1.73 A / ~1.3 A. Matters only in an output short.
findings.evidence: AN_SY8303 elec. table; SLVSDG6C 5.5; LCSC attributes

findings.finding: 5 V-only port: +5V about 4.4 V (Dmax 87 %). With a 5 V-only PD source, firmware takes VBUS as 20 V (R3-POWER-4); PG keeps Q1 off, so this is harmless but silent.
